description: This file contains extension methods for DaemonSet listing, including functions to retrieve DaemonSets associated with Pods and ControllerRevisions within the Kubernetes client-go project.

classes.name: daemonSetLister
classes.description: A struct implementing methods to list DaemonSets, with functions to find DaemonSets related to Pods and ControllerRevisions.

methods.name: GetPodDaemonSets
methods.description: Returns DaemonSets that potentially match a given Pod based on labels and namespace.

methods.name: GetHistoryDaemonSets
methods.description: Returns DaemonSets that potentially match a given ControllerRevision based on labels and namespace.
